title: Neon Lanes
objective: Drive as far as possible across three neon lanes, collecting coins while dodging pink X blocks and jumping over orange barriers.
controls: Swipe left or right to switch lanes; swipe up to jump over barriers.
core_loop: Switch lanes and jump to dodge obstacles while collecting coins to increase distance and score as speed escalates.
progression: Distance and speed (SPD) continuously increase the longer the player survives, punctuated by coin milestones like 50 Coins.
hook_idea: High-speed magnet run pulling in streams of coins and jumping an orange barrier at t=20.0-22.0s
